Bi/BOC exhibits a noble metal like activity as a cocatalyst in the photocatalytic oxidation reaction under visible light irradiations.

the Bi nanoparticle deposited on the (BiO) 2CO3 microsphere exhibits a plasmon effect, which is beneficial for photocatalysis, and that the Bi nanopart. deposited on the (BOC) microsphere exhibits a highly enhanced photocatalytic efficiency for NO removal in air under visible-light irradiation.
the plasmonic Bi/BOC photocatalyst exhibits a high activity and oxidation ability, and that the SPR effect plays a significant role in the enhanced activity of the photocatalyst.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of plasmonic Bi/BOC microspheres, which exhibit a high visible light driven photocatalytic activity for NO removal.
the preparation and characterization of Bi/BOC photocatalysts, and the application of the Bi/BOC as a visible light photocatalyst for the removal of NO.

the synthesis of Bi nanoparticle deposited BOC microspheres and their applications in photocatalysis, which provides an alternative strategy for the preparation of noble metal like plasmonic photocatalysts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SPR effect of Bi nanoparticles plays an important role in the enhanced photocatalytic performance.
the Bi/BOC microspheres exhibited a noble metal like behavior and were promising for the photocatalysis of environmental pollutants.

the plasmonic Bi/BOC photocatalyst exhibits a high photocatalytic activity, which is attributed to the synergistic effect of plasmonic Bi, (BiO) 2CO3 and SPR effect, and the Bi/BOC composite can be a potential candidate as a photocatalyst in environmental remediation.

noble metal like behavior of plasmonic Bi particles deposited on (BiO2)CO3 micros.

noble metal like behavior of plasmonic Bi particles deposited on (BiO2CO3 microsphere as a cocatalyst for efficient visible light photocatalysis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the plasmonic Bi nanoparticle deposited on (BiO)(2)CO3 micros. can serve as an excellent cocatalyst to enhance the photocatalytic activity of (BiO)(.2)CO3 for visible light induced NO removal.
the noble metal like plasmonic Bi particles can be used as a cocatalyst for efficient visible light driven photocatalysis.
